WITH dec_cases AS (
    SELECT c.*
    FROM cases c
    WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
employer_volume AS (
    SELECT homefirm, COUNT(*) AS case_count
    FROM dec_cases
    GROUP BY homefirm
),
case_features AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.homefirm,
        c.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
        c.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
        substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
        pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        CASE
            WHEN ev.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN ev.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN ev.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            ELSE '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band,
        c.headct
    FROM dec_cases c
    JOIN employer_volume ev ON ev.homefirm = c.homefirm
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
case_load AS (
    SELECT
        f.filekey,
        f.homefirm,
        ev.case_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.base_hours + r.position_hours * f.headct), 0) AS review_hours
    FROM case_features f
    JOIN employer_volume ev ON ev.homefirm = f.homefirm
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
        ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = f.visa_class)
       AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = f.wage_level)
       AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = f.h1b_dependent)
       AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = f.soc_major_group)
       AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = f.worksite_state)
       AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = f.monthly_volume_band)
    GROUP BY f.filekey, f.homefirm, ev.case_count
)
SELECT
    homefirm AS employer_name,
    ROUND(SUM(review_hours), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM case_load
WHERE case_count >= 5
GROUP BY homefirm
ORDER BY employer_review_load DESC, employer_name
```sql
LIMIT 5;
```

WITH parsed_cases AS (
    SELECT c.*, try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')::DATE AS start_date
    FROM cases c
),
monthly_volume AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE AS start_month,
        count(*) AS case_volume
    FROM parsed_cases
    WHERE start_date IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY homefirm, date_trunc('month', start_date)::DATE
),
december_cases AS (
    SELECT
        p.*,
        mv.case_volume,
        CASE
            WHEN mv.case_volume = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN mv.case_volume BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN mv.case_volume BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN mv.case_volume >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END AS volume_band
    FROM parsed_cases p
    JOIN monthly_volume mv
      ON mv.homefirm = p.homefirm
     AND mv.start_month = date_trunc('month', p.start_date)::DATE
    WHERE date_trunc('month', p.start_date) = DATE '2023-12-01'
),
case_facts AS (
    SELECT
        d.filekey,
        d.homefirm,
        d.headct,
        d.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
        d.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
        d.soccd,
        cw.wsstate,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
        d.volume_band
    FROM december_cases d
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = d.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
candidate_rules AS (
    SELECT
        f.filekey,
        f.homefirm,
        f.headct,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity
    FROM case_facts f
    LEFT JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = f.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = f.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = f.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = substr(f.soccd, 1, 2))
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = f.wsstate)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = f.volume_band)
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY filekey
            ORDER BY (rule_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM candidate_rules
),
case_hours AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        filekey,
        coalesce(base_hours, 3.50) + coalesce(position_hours, 0.50) * headct AS review_hours
    FROM ranked_rules
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    homefirm AS employer_name,
    round(sum(review_hours), 2) AS employer_review_load
FROM case_hours
GROUP BY homefirm
HAVING count(*) >= 5
ORDER BY employer_review_load DESC, employer_name ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH case_info AS (
    SELECT
        c.filekey,
        c.homefirm,
        substr(c.recvday, 1, 7) AS recv_month,
        c.headct,
        c.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
        pw.wage_details -> 'prevailing_wage' ->> 'level' AS wage_level,
        c.h1bdep::VARCHAR AS h1b_dependent,
        split_part(c.soccd, '-', 1) AS soc_major_group,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM cases c2
            WHERE c2.homefirm = c.homefirm
              AND substr(c2.recvday, 1, 7) = substr(c.recvday, 1, 7)
        ) AS monthly_case_count
    FROM cases c
    JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE c.filekey = 'I-200-23355-583990'
),
matching_rules AS (
    SELECT
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        ci.headct,
        (
            CASE WHEN r.visa_class IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.wage_level IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM review_schedule r
    CROSS JOIN case_info ci
    WHERE (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ci.visa_class)
      AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ci.wage_level)
      AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ci.h1b_dependent)
      AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ci.soc_major_group)
      AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ci.worksite_state)

),

    SELECT

        COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) AS case_count
    FROM base_cases
    GROUP BY received_month
),
case_attributes AS (

        b.*,
        cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,

            WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'

The Employer Wage Assurance Score is **19.10**.

```sql
WITH case_wage AS (
  SELECT
    c.headct,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from') AS offered_from,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') AS offered_unit,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value') AS prevailing_value,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') AS prevailing_unit,
    json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
  FROM cases c
  JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  WHERE c.homefirm = 'WIPRO LIMITED'
    AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'
    AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
annualized AS (
  SELECT
    headct,
    CAST(replace(replace(offered_from, '$', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) *
      CASE offered_unit
        WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
        WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
        WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
        WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
      END AS aow,
    CAST(replace(replace(prevailing_value, 'USD ', ''), ',', '') AS DOUBLE) *
      CASE prevailing_unit
        WHEN 'Hour' THEN 2080
        WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
        WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
        WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
      END AS apw,
    wage_level
  FROM case_wage
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    headct,
    0.7 * 100 * least(greatest((aow - apw) / apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40
      + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
          WHEN 'I' THEN 25
          WHEN 'II' THEN 50
          WHEN 'III' THEN 75
          WHEN 'IV' THEN 100
          ELSE 50
        END AS cwas
  FROM annualized
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(cwas * headct) / SUM(headct), 2) AS employer_wage_assurance_score
FROM scored;
```

```sql
WITH governed AS (

         g.base_hours, g.position_hours
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN (
    WITH ca AS (
      SELECT c2.filekey, CAST(c2.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
             pw2.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
             CAST(c2.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent,
             substr(c2.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
             cw2.wsstate AS worksite_state,
             CASE WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
                  WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
                  WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
                  ELSE '15+' END AS monthly_volume_band
      FROM main.cases c2
      JOIN main.case_worksite cw2 ON cw2.dockkey = c2.filekey
      JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw2 ON pw2.trackno = cw2.wagetrack
      JOIN (
        SELECT homefirm, date_trunc('month', strptime(beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
               COUNT(*) AS emcv
        FROM main.cases
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ) v ON v.homefirm = c2.homefirm
         AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', strptime(c2.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
    )
    SELECT ca.filekey, r.rule_id AS governing_rule_id,
           COALESCE(r.base_hours, 3.50) AS base_hours,
           COALESCE(r.position_hours, 0.50) AS position_hours
    FROM ca
    LEFT JOIN main.review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = ca.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1b_dependent)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = ca.soc_major_group)
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = ca.worksite_state)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)

      PARTITION BY ca.filekey

              + CASE WHEN r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
```

```sql
WITH december_cases AS (
    SELECT c.filekey, c.homefirm
    FROM cases AS c
    WHERE try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND try_strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') <  DATE '2024-01-01'
),
normalized_wages AS (
    SELECT
        d.filekey,
        d.homefirm,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'),
            '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
        )::DOUBLE
        * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit')
            WHEN 'Year'  THEN 1
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Week'  THEN 52
            WHEN 'Hour'  THEN 2080
          END AS offered_annual,
        regexp_replace(
            json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'),
            '[^0-9.]', '', 'g'
        )::DOUBLE
        * CASE json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit')
            WHEN 'Year'  THEN 1
            WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
            WHEN 'Week'  THEN 52
            WHEN 'Hour'  THEN 2080
          END AS prevailing_annual
    FROM december_cases AS d
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw ON cw.dockkey = d.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
employer_scores AS (
    SELECT
        homefirm,
        COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) AS case_count,
        ROUND(100.0 * AVG(offered_annual / prevailing_annual), 2) AS score
    FROM normalized_wages
    WHERE offered_annual IS NOT NULL
      AND prevailing_annual IS NOT NULL
      AND prevailing_annual > 0
    GROUP BY homefirm
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT filekey) >= 5
)
SELECT homefirm AS employer_name, score
FROM employer_scores
ORDER BY score DESC, homefirm
LIMIT 5;
```

```sql
            replace(replace(json_extract_string(wage_details, '$.offered_wage.from'), '$', ''), ',', '')
            AS DOUBLE
```
```sql
        ) AS offered_amount,
```
```sql
        CAST(
            replace(replace(json_extract_string(wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), 'USD ', ''), ',', '')
            AS DOUBLE
        ) AS prevailing_amount,
        json_extract_string(wage_details, '$.offered_wage.unit') AS offered_unit,
        json_extract_string(wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.unit') AS prevailing_unit,
        json_extract_string(wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM june_cases

                    WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                    WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                    WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
                END
                -

                CASE prevailing_unit

                    WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                    WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                    WHEN 'Year' THEN 1

                    WHEN 'Week' THEN 52
                    WHEN 'Month' THEN 12
                    WHEN 'Year' THEN 1
                END

        CASE wage_level

            WHEN 'II' THEN 50
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75
            WHEN 'IV' THEN 100

    FROM wage_inputs
```

Using each applicable review-schedule rule’s `base_hours + position_hours × headCt` as the case score, the averages are **13.20** for dependent cases and **10.53** for non-dependent cases. Monthly volume is based on the employer’s cases received in that month.

```sql
WITH monthly_volume AS (
  SELECT
    homefirm,
    substr(recvday, 1, 7) AS recv_month,
    COUNT(*) AS case_count
  FROM cases
  GROUP BY homefirm, substr(recvday, 1, 7)
),
case_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
    c.h1bdep,
    c.visacls::VARCHAR AS visa_class,
    c.soccd,
    c.headct,
    CASE
      WHEN mv.case_count = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN mv.case_count BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM cases c
  JOIN monthly_volume mv
    ON mv.homefirm = c.homefirm
   AND mv.recv_month = substr(c.recvday, 1, 7)
  WHERE substr(c.beginday, 7, 4) = '2024'
    AND substr(c.beginday, 4, 2) = '01'
    AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
matched_rules AS (
  SELECT
    ca.filekey,
    ca.h1bdep,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours + r.position_hours * ca.headct AS score
  FROM case_attrs ca
  JOIN review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = ca.visa_class)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = ca.h1bdep)
   AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = substr(ca.soccd, 1, 2))
   AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = ca.monthly_volume_band)
   AND (
     (r.worksite_state IS NULL AND r.wage_level IS NULL)
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM case_worksite cw
       LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw
         ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
       WHERE cw.dockkey = ca.filekey
         AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = cw.wsstate)
         AND (
           r.wage_level IS NULL
           OR r.wage_level =
              json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level')
         )
     )
   )
),
case_scores AS (
  SELECT
    ca.filekey,
    ca.h1bdep,
    COALESCE(SUM(mr.score), 0) AS score
  FROM case_attrs ca
  LEFT JOIN matched_rules mr
    ON mr.filekey = ca.filekey
  GROUP BY ca.filekey, ca.h1bdep
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(score) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
  ROUND(AVG(score) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM case_scores;
```

```sql
                WHEN 'Year'  THEN 1.0
            END AS apw,
        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level
    FROM cases AS c
    JOIN case_worksite AS cw
        ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
    JOIN prevailing_wage AS pw
        ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    WHERE strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y') < DATE '2024-02-01'
      AND c.h1bdep IN ('Yes', 'No')
),
scores AS (
    SELECT
        h1bdep,
        0.7 * (
            100.0 * least(greatest((aow - apw) / apw, 0.0), 0.40) / 0.40
        ) + 0.3 * CASE wage_level
            WHEN 'I'   THEN 25.0
            WHEN 'II'  THEN 50.0
            WHEN 'III' THEN 75.0
            WHEN 'IV'  THEN 100.0
            ELSE 50.0
        END AS cwas
    FROM wage_inputs
)
SELECT
    round(avg(cwas) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'Yes'), 2) AS avg_yes,
    round(avg(cwas) FILTER (WHERE h1bdep = 'No'), 2) AS avg_no
FROM scores;
```

           replace(replace(json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.value'), 'USD ', ''), ',', '')

```sql
annual AS (
```

```sql
    WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00032'
      AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-01'
),
ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT
        t.casenum,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge,
        rr.charge_pct,
        row_number() OVER (
            PARTITION BY t.casenum
            ORDER BY
                (
                    (rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
                    + (

                    )

    END
```

```sql
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
counted AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (
            PARTITION BY profilenum, date_trunc('month', return_date)
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM return_facts
),
applicable AS (
    SELECT
        f.casenum,
        f.unit_value,
        cr.rule_id,
        cr.customer_segment,
        cr.flat_charge,
        cr.charge_pct,
        (cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL)::INT
        + (cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL)::INT
        + (cr.item_category IS NOT NULL)::INT

        + (cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL)::INT

    FROM counted f
```

```sql
        o.buyerlink AS customer_id,
```
```sql
        p.unit_value::DOUBLE AS unit_value,
```
```sql
        CAST(json_extract_string(
            qa.assessment_summary, '$.results.aesthetic_score'
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS aesthetic_score,
        json_extract_string(
            qa.assessment_summary, '$.condition.completeness'
        ) AS completeness,
        CAST(json_extract_string(
            r.return_details, '$.shipping.fee'
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS shipping_fee
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
    WHERE r.revdate LIKE '2025-02%'
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count,
        SUM(
            unit_value
            - (unit_value * aesthetic_score / 10.0) *
                CASE completeness
                    WHEN 'Complete' THEN 1.00
                    WHEN 'Accessories Missing' THEN 0.85
                    WHEN 'Missing Parts' THEN 0.60
                END
            + shipping_fee
        ) AS total_leakage,
        SUM(unit_value) AS total_unit_value
    FROM feb_returns
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    ROUND(total_leakage / total_unit_value, 2) AS clr
FROM monthly
WHERE return_count >= 3
ORDER BY total_leakage / total_unit_value DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 5;
```

Using the most-specific matching charge rule for each February return, and defining CLR as the unpaid share of expected charges, CUS00080 falls in the **High** leakage class with a CLR of **0.77**.

```sql
WITH customer_returns AS (
    SELECT
        r.casenum,
        c.seg_category,
        r.return_channel,
        p.itemcategory,
        r.return_details->'reasoning'->>'primary_reason' AS primary_reason,
        qa.assessment_summary->'condition'->>'item_condition' AS item_condition,
        COALESCE(p.unit_value, 0) AS unit_value,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(fm.cost_breakdown->'fees'->>'restocking_fee' AS DOUBLE),
            0
        ) AS actual_charge,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM returns r2
            JOIN orders o2 ON o2.txnnum = r2.srctxn
            WHERE o2.buyerlink = 'CUS00080'
              AND TRY_CAST(r2.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-02-01'
              AND TRY_CAST(r2.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01'
        ) AS monthly_returns
    FROM returns r
    JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    LEFT JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN quality_assessment qa ON qa.inspectref = r.casenum
    LEFT JOIN financial_management fm ON fm.casetag = r.casenum
    WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00080'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-02-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(r.revdate AS DATE) < DATE '2025-03-01'
),
eligible_rules AS (
    SELECT
        cr.casenum,
        cr.actual_charge,
        rr.rule_id,
        rr.flat_charge + cr.unit_value * rr.charge_pct / 100.0 AS expected_charge,
        (
            CASE WHEN rr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          + CASE WHEN rr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS specificity
    FROM customer_returns cr
    JOIN return_charge_rules rr
      ON (rr.customer_segment IS NULL OR rr.customer_segment = cr.seg_category)
     AND (rr.return_channel IS NULL OR rr.return_channel = cr.return_channel)
     AND (rr.item_category IS NULL OR rr.item_category = cr.itemcategory)
     AND (rr.primary_reason IS NULL OR rr.primary_reason = cr.primary_reason)
     AND (rr.item_condition IS NULL OR rr.item_condition = cr.item_condition)
     AND (rr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rr.min_monthly_returns <= cr.monthly_returns)
     AND (rr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR rr.max_monthly_returns >= cr.monthly_returns)
),
selected_rule AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY casenum
            ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM eligible_rules
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(expected_charge) AS expected_total,
        SUM(actual_charge) AS collected_total
    FROM selected_rule
    WHERE rn = 1
),
clr_calc AS (
    SELECT CASE
        WHEN expected_total = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE GREATEST(expected_total - collected_total, 0) / expected_total
    END AS clr
    FROM totals
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN clr >= 0.50 THEN 'High'
        WHEN clr >= 0.20 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS leakage_class,
    ROUND(clr, 2) AS clr
FROM clr_calc;
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_yields AS (
  SELECT
```
```sql
    CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
    CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.availability_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS availability_pct,
    CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
```
```sql
  WHERE pm.pnlkind = 'Bifacial'
    AND pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
),
losses AS (
  SELECT
    energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0))
      - energy_kwh AS recoverable_loss_kwh
  FROM snapshot_yields
  WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
    AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
    AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
)

FROM losses;
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_yields AS (
  SELECT
    pm.pnlkind,
    date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS snapshot_month,
    CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
    CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.availability_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS availability_pct,
    CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
),
calculated AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    snapshot_month,
    energy_kwh,
    energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS potential_kwh
  FROM snapshot_yields
  WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
    AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
    AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    snapshot_month,
    SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh) AS recoverable_kwh,
    SUM(potential_kwh) AS potential_kwh
  FROM calculated
  GROUP BY pnlkind, snapshot_month
)

  CASE
    WHEN 100.0 * recoverable_kwh / potential_kwh < 6 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN 100.0 * recoverable_kwh / potential_kwh < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
    WHEN 100.0 * recoverable_kwh / potential_kwh < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
    ELSE 'Severe'
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        pm.pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', pr.snapts) AS snapshot_month,
        CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS yield_kwh,
        CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.cumulative_deg_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS deg_pct
    FROM plant_record AS pr
    JOIN plants AS p
        ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models AS pm
        ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance AS ep
        ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
      AND pr.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
),
technology_months AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        snapshot_month,
        SUM(yield_kwh * deg_pct / 100.0) AS recoverable_energy,
        AVG(deg_pct) AS avg_deg_pct
    FROM snapshot_metrics
    WHERE yield_kwh IS NOT NULL
      AND deg_pct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY pnlkind, snapshot_month
),
banded AS (
    SELECT
        recoverable_energy,
        CASE
            WHEN avg_deg_pct >= 10 THEN 'Severe'
            WHEN avg_deg_pct >= 5 THEN 'Moderate'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS energy_loss_band
    FROM technology_months
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN energy_loss_band = 'Severe' THEN recoverable_energy ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(recoverable_energy), 0),
    2
) AS severe_share_pct
FROM banded;
```

```sql
      / NULLIF(SUM(potential_kwh), 0) AS loss_ratio
```
```sql
  FROM yields
  WHERE potential_kwh IS NOT NULL
```
```sql
    AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pnlkind, date_trunc('month', snapts)
),
banded AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    CASE
      WHEN loss_ratio < 6 THEN 'Low'
      WHEN loss_ratio < 10 THEN 'Moderate'
      WHEN loss_ratio < 14 THEN 'Elevated'
      ELSE 'Severe'
    END AS loss_band
  FROM monthly
  WHERE loss_ratio IS NOT NULL
),
snapshot_losses AS (
  SELECT
    y.loss_kwh,
    b.loss_band
  FROM (
    SELECT
      y.*,
      y.potential_kwh - y.energy_kwh AS loss_kwh
    FROM yields y
  ) y
  JOIN banded b
    ON b.pnlkind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM y.pnlkind
   AND b.month = date_trunc('month', y.snapts)
  WHERE y.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
    AND y.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01'
    AND y.potential_kwh IS NOT NULL
    AND y.energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  loss_band,
  COUNT(*) AS snapshots,
  ROUND(AVG(loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM snapshot_losses
WHERE loss_band IN ('Severe', 'Low')
GROUP BY loss_band
ORDER BY CASE loss_band WHEN 'Severe' THEN 1 WHEN 'Low' THEN 2 END;
```
